findings.explanation: Detailed implementation duplicates steps 1-4 and appends generic modular input/HEC boilerplate that contradicts the NetApp ONTAP EMS syslog guidance.
findings.quote:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Vendor TA, syslog — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=netapp:ontap:ems into storage. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the duplicated boilerplate block and consolidate into a single NetApp EMS failover guide.

summary: Impacted by title-salad descriptions, duplicated implementation sections with generic boilerplate, and formulaic exception registers.
